text:
maya: kicking off preflight for the midnight quiet-window cutover. main ask: confirm API/runtime/console/router pins and rollback signal. deploying v2.3.0-runtime + api v1.12. Should we pin router header split?

deploy-bot: [automated] preflight started by maya at 2025-02-06T23:40:34Z. Required checks: dep-compat, canary-schedule, release-note, rollback-plan. Reply `deploy-bot approve` to proceed with canary.

sanjay: runtime v2.3.0 includes kernel batching toggle. we need kv-eviction pin for older shards — recommend pin eviction=false for first 30m canary.

eli: console needs the new trace schema change in 1.12 to render request ids. we ship UI change in a hotfix branch — will push console tag `console-ui@2025-02-06-hotfix`. confirm version in release notes.

maya: noting: runtime kernel batching on by default in v2.3.0. Sanjay — set `kv_eviction: false` in the runtime pin config?

sanjay: yes `kv_eviction:false` for canary window. command: `kubectl apply -f runtime-pin-canary.yaml` (will do once deploy-bot gives green)

ops-jen: router team here — router header split needs a schema toggle off for older clients. we'll set `header-split: staged` and keep legacy header allowed for 1h. also adding route fallback to `api-v1.11` in case of 5xx spike.

courtney: adding release notes draft: bullet points: runtime v2.3.0 (kernel batching), api v1.12 (trace ids), console hotfix (trace schema), router staged header split + fallback. also include rollback steps and contact list. ping when updated.

eli: note for release notes: call out that embeddings endpoint has no behavior change but latency profile may improve. include sample `curl` to validate.

maya: quick callout on rollback criteria: >=3% user-facing errors for 10m OR canary latency P95 > 300ms for 5m — auto-rollback. is that agreed?

sanjay: agree. add KV miss rate spike > 200% as a soft-trigger we watch manually.

deploy-bot: [automated] dependency check: api v1.12 compatible with runtime v2.3.0: OK. console hotfix tag present: OK. router fallback route present: OK. Canary window scheduled at 00:30 UTC for 30 minutes.

maya: small nit — update deploy note to pin `model-serving@sha:abc123` on dedicated so workload uses quantized variant. otherwise cost jump on burst.

courtney: added contact list and step-by-step rollback to release notes, pushed to `release-notes/drafts/1758881234.md` (internal).

ops-jen: router will monitor header-split 5xx per shard and post to #incidents. I'll keep an eye during canary.

maya: ok — can I get a thumbs up from each team? reply with :thumbsup: to confirm pins and rollback thresholds.

sanjay: :thumbsup: (will hold off autoscaling changes during canary)

eli: :thumbsup: (console hotfix pinned)

ops-jen: :thumbsup: (router fallback ready)

courtney: :thumbsup: (release notes + contacts)

deploy-bot: `deploy-bot approve` received. initiating canary at 1758882200 (scheduled). will post status updates and provide `deploy-bot abort` hook. :rocket:
